newsitem.title: UK: Hanson gains for second day in active trade.
newsitem.headline: Hanson gains for second day in active trade.

text.p: Shares in Hanson Plc rose strongly for a second day, hitting the highest level since it made its debut following the demerger last month of the former conglomerate's Energy Group Plc unit.
Dealers said they were not aware of any specific reason for the rise but said there were hopes of a recovery in the stock after its recent unsteady performance.
"There has been some fairly decent London buying," said one market-maker.
The stock was up 11-1/2p or 3.8 percent at 298-1/2 by 1410 GMT, after reaching a high of 300p -- its highest since it reached 302p on its market debut -- in active trade of 3.6 million shares.
